title: How booking works
content: Booking has three steps: choose a service, choose which pet it's for, then pick a date and time from the calendar. You'll get a booking ID and can view it any time from your Profile page under the Bookings tab.

title: How to reschedule
content: Open the booking from your Profile > Bookings tab, click Reschedule, pick a new date and time from the calendar, then save. The clinic will be notified of the change automatically.

title: How to cancel a booking
content: Open the booking from your Profile > Bookings tab and click Cancel booking. Cancelled bookings cannot be restored — you'll need to create a new one if you change your mind.

title: What happens after I book
content: After booking, your appointment appears as Upcoming in your profile. The clinic may reach out via WhatsApp to confirm. On the day of your visit, arrive 5-10 minutes early.

title: Booking a home visit
content: Home Visit is bookable the same way as any other service — select 'Home Visit' as the service during booking. A vet will come to your address at the scheduled time.
